drain.label: Exposition stacking
drain.description: Consecutive stretches of background with nobody wanting anything — you're being briefed, not taken somewhere.

drain.label: No open question
drain.description: Nothing is unresolved at the end of a beat, so there's no reason to stay for the next one.

drain.label: Trope fatigue
drain.description: A character beat or plot move you've already heard a hundred times — the story is going exactly where you expected.

drain.label: Character overload
drain.description: Too many new voices arriving too close together, making it impossible to know whose story this is.

drain.label: Unclear point of view
drain.description: You can't tell whose experience you're supposed to be tracking, so no one's stakes land.

drain.label: Stakes too low
drain.description: What's at risk doesn't feel worth caring about, so neither the tension nor the resolution matters.

drain.label: Flat pacing
drain.description: The beat moves at the same emotional speed as the last several beats — no lift, no drop, no shift.

drain.label: Payoff too far away
drain.description: The question was opened so long ago and has been deferred so many times that you've stopped waiting for the answer.

drain.label: Tonal whiplash
drain.description: The emotional register shifts abruptly — from comic to tragic or tense to breezy — without a bridge to carry you across.

drain.label: Unvoiced dialogue
drain.description: Characters speak in a way that sounds written rather than spoken — interchangeable voices that could belong to anyone.

refill.label: Question opened
refill.description: Something new is left unresolved, pulling you into the next beat to find out what happens.

refill.label: Stakes escalated
refill.description: What a character stands to lose just got bigger or more real, making the outcome matter more.

refill.label: Novel premise
refill.description: A situation or combination you haven't encountered before — the story is going somewhere unfamiliar.

refill.label: Emotional hit
refill.description: A moment of genuine feeling — grief, joy, recognition — that makes the story feel true.

refill.label: Tension spike
refill.description: The immediate situation tips into danger or urgency, raising your heart rate before you've thought about it.

refill.label: Satisfying trope
refill.description: A familiar story beat lands exactly as hoped — the pleasure of the expected, delivered well.

refill.label: Distinctive voice
refill.description: A character speaks in a way that could only be them — you'd know the voice with your eyes closed.
